digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler destructive repair pause control
propositions: Destructive repair (fsck, doctor) must acquire durable, provider-neutral pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate before any mutation
Repair sequence is fail-closed: verify git email, read pause OID+document, generate token, CAS-write pause, verify lock, execute repair, cleanup by observed OID matching token
Pause acquisition or lock check failure aborts repair; pre-existing pause, missing git email, CAS miss, or uncertain lock state all prevent destructive mutation
Cleanup must reread pause and OID as one snapshot, clear only if reason equals invocation token, and leave durable pause for operator recovery on any CAS miss
read_pause_with_oid reads one ref OID exactly once and decodes document from observed object; existing read_pause callers delegate and discard OID for compatibility
All repair surfaces (fsck, doctor) remove GitHub CLI workflow-disable/enable dependency and share provider-neutral pause contract across local, GHA, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments
